# Feature
## US1: Responsive progress
Users see progress rather than a frozen screen.
### Acceptance
Progress appears within one second.
## US2: Delete history
Unrelated deletion removes all history.
## Global constraints
NFR-001: Stay in the single container because deployment has no queue service.
## Functional requirements
| ID | Requirement | User Story |
|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Show progress | US1 |
| FR-002 | Delete everything | US2 |
| FR-003 | Ownership unclear | |
